title: TimeSeriesExamAgent: Creating Time Series Reasoning Benchmarks at Scale

claim.summary: TimeSeriesExamAgent generates executable question templates for user datasets and iteratively filters their execution, content and capability discrimination.

modules.name: Temporal question-template generation
modules.scope_reason: Templates encode question logic, options, selection of instances and answer computation. The produced artifact is a QA exam, so multiple concept/domain coverage does not make it task-independent; move GTS to TSK.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; passage beginning "We propose TimeSeriesExamAgent"

modules.name: Capability-aligned template filtering
modules.scope_reason: Relative accuracy of weaker and stronger test-takers provides a general template-quality filter, separate from temporal question content.
